title: LinuxifyMC
description: A Minecraft Plugin which adds simulated Linux commands to Minecraft
body:
# LinuxifyMC
LinuxifyMC is a Minecraft Plugin which adds simulated Linux commands to Minecraft, as well as a ext4-like filesystem with a Database. Some of the commands included are help, cd, ls, mkdir, echo. This plugin also contains some non-linux commands, as well as settings which you can set either for the whole server or for yourself using the /linuxifymc command.

# Why would i need this?
You might want this plugin if you want to add the Linux vibes to Minecraft by being allowed to execute linux commands in Minecraft.

# Is this plugin Open-Source?
Yes, this plugin is fully Open-Source, and you can check the source-code at [https://github.com/opuadm/LinuxifyMC](https://github.com/opuadm/LinuxifyMC).

# Why did you make this plugin?
I made this plugin because there were lots of plugins like this one that didn't have many things, or just didn't receive any updates at all.

# Notes
If you find any bugs, feel free to report any at [https://github.com/opuadm/LinuxifyMC/issues](https://github.com/opuadm/LinuxifyMC/issues).

If you want to know what is PROBABLY upcoming, you might want to check [TODO.md](https://github.com/LinuxifyMC/LinuxifyMC/blob/testing/TODO.md).

This plugin **REQUIRES** Java 21 or later.
